name: rankly
description: Rankly - Launch. Rank. Grow. A paid project discovery and ranking platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
